content: AUTOSAR RTE shall support a bypass implementation Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR shall provide support for implementation of bypass A bypass consists of directly reading/modifying/writing data managed by the RTE for the purpose of testing or rapid prototyping Rationale: To support the integration on a standard AUT OSAR software of different implementatio ns of bypass tools and software Use Case: A Rapid Prototyping tool/software vendor provides an implementation that can be integrated on a standard RTE. A Tier 1 supplier integrates the Rapid Prototyping software in an AUTOSAR ECU. The Rapid Prototyping tool is used by an OEM on the ECU provided by the Tier 1 supplier to evaluate/test new control algorithms Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: --
